patch.value: Dependabot PRs blocked: untagged releases make changelog:check drift daily and the exact CLI pin ERESOLVEs against pm-changelog 2026.8.17

Daily Release publishes npm before pushing the tag; publish 404s left v2026.08.22..v2026.08.24 untagged while their release commits landed on main, so pm-changelog --all-release-tags synthesizes a pending window dated 'now' and every CI run after the release day fails changelog:check. Separately, the exact devDependency pin @unbrained/pm-cli@2026.8.15 conflicts with pm-changelog@2026.8.17's peer floor >=2026.8.16, so that bump PR cannot even npm ci.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: ROOT CAUSE (from CI logs 32611471740/32611476237/32611478369, reproduced locally): (1) test (22)/(26) on the pm-ops and pm-cli bump PRs fail at 'Verify generated changelog': committed heading '## 2026.8.22 - 2026-08-22' vs generated '- <today>'. resolveReleaseTagWindows() in pm-changelog folds an untagged package.json version into a pending window stamped new Date().toISOString(), so the heading changes every UTC day. Tags stop at v2026.08.17 because release.yml pushes the tag only after npm publish, and publish failed with repeated registry 404s while the release commits still landed on main. (2) The pm-changelog bump PR fails earlier at npm ci with ERESOLVE: exact devDependency pin @unbrained/pm-cli@2026.8.15 violates pm-changelog@2026.8.17's peer requirement >=2026.8.16. Note: no CI log contains test/kill.test.ts; that name only appears as an intentional failing fixture inside scripts/coverage-gate.ts self-tests whose captured child output leaks into logs when a parent assertion fails.

patch.value: Fixed on fix/backfill-release-tags-and-float-cli-devdep: (1) backfilled lightweight release tags v2026.08.22->8beb438, v2026.08.23->7b59d18, v2026.08.24->ca2c8c3 exactly as release.yml creates them, so --all-release-tags derives heading dates from tag commit timestamps instead of a now()-stamped pending window; CHANGELOG.md regenerated via npm run changelog:full and changelog:check now passes deterministically on any UTC day. (2) bumped exact devDependency pin @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.15 -> 2026.8.23 so npm ci resolves with pm-changelog@2026.8.17 peer >=2026.8.16 (verified in a simulated rebase of that PR branch).
